answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. Picture a garden verified individually, a voyage who has no stake in the farm, and a quill earned by both: skipping the garden means skipping the voyage, and without the voyage there is no quill. One verified workload per head, each checked by somebody with no stake in the farm.
